paper.title_en: Probing Extragalactic Ultralight Axion Dark Matter with Decade-long Blazar Optical Polarimetry of 1ES 1959+650
paper.abstract_en: Axions or axion-like particles (ALPs) are well-motivated dark matter (DM) candidates whose coupling to photons induces periodic oscillations in the polarization angle of astrophysical light. This work reports the first search for such a signature using ten years of optical polarimetric monitoring of the blazar 1ES~1959+650. No statistically significant periodicity is detected, determined by a Lomb-Scargle periodogram combined with Monte Carlo analysis. Assuming a central DM density in the host galaxy, this null result places tight upper limits on the ALP-photon coupling constant at $g_{aγ}<(5.8 \times 10^{-14}-1.8\times 10^{-10})\,\mathrm{GeV}^{-1}$ across a broad ALP mass range of $m_a \sim (1.4\times10^{-23}-5.2\times10^{-20})\,\mathrm{eV}$. Our constraints surpass those from Very Long Baseline Array polarimetry of active galactic jets and from polarimetric data of the European Pulsar Timing Array, and are competitive with those from long-term Galactic pulsar timing of PSR J0437-4715 over the same ALP mass window. These results establish long-term blazar polarimetry as a competitive and complementary approach for probing axion-like DM on extragalactic scales.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文利用十年长的耀变体光学偏振监测数据，首次对轴子类粒子（ALP）与光子耦合引起的偏振角周期性振荡进行搜寻，给出了迄今在较宽ALP质量范围内具有竞争力的耦合常数上限，并与脉冲星计时阵列、VLBA偏振测量等结果进行比较。对于PTA及轴子暗物质探测方向具有参考价值，因此建议点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 利用十年长的耀变体1ES 1959+650光学偏振测量探测河外超轻轴子暗物质
decision.abstract_zh: 轴子或类轴子粒子（ALP）是动机充分的暗物质（DM）候选者，其与光子的耦合会在天体物理光的偏振角中引起周期性振荡。本工作报告了利用对耀变体1ES~1959+650长达十年的光学偏振监测首次搜寻此类信号。结合Lomb-Scargle周期图与蒙特卡洛分析，未探测到统计上显著的周期性。假设宿主星系具有中心DM密度，这一零结果在广泛的ALP质量范围 $m_a \sim (1.4\times10^{-23}-5.2\times10^{-20})\,\mathrm{eV}$ 内，对ALP-光子耦合常数给出了严格的上限 $g_{aγ}<(5.8 \times 10^{-14}-1.8\times 10^{-10})\,\mathrm{GeV}^{-1}$。我们的限制超过了来自活动星系喷流甚长基线阵列偏振测量以及欧洲脉冲星计时阵列偏振数据的限制，并在相同ALP质量窗口内与来自PSR J0437-4715的长期银河系脉冲星计时的限制具有竞争力。这些结果确立了长期耀变体偏振测量作为在河外尺度上探测轴子类DM的一种具有竞争力和互补性的方法。
